reason: Creators already walk into my salon every month offering a reel, and I find the rest on Instagram myself and pay them by UPI. I don't need someone to match me, and my clients book by phone or WhatsApp, so I don't see my staff tapping +1 for a promo code.
objection: A 10% fee plus GST on top of the creator's fee adds up when margins are thin, and I'd be paying it for introductions I can get free in my DMs. Also a salon booking isn't a café counter, so I doubt the code tracking will capture who really came because of the reel.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from another Bengaluru salon or gym that a Mitra-matched creator brought in clearly more paying bookings than the creators who approach me for free, with the cost per customer shown.
